docs: Anchor-compatible IDL for the Phoenix Eternal program.

Instructions marked optionalTrailingAdditionalFeeConfig accept legacy args followed by a Borsh AdditionalFeeConfig, without a Borsh Option tag. No suffix means zero fees. Rates are u8 tenths of a basis point (0..255 = 0..25.5 bps). MakerAndTaker encodes [0, maker, taker]; MakerOnly encodes [1, maker] and sets taker to zero. MakerTakerAndConditionalTaker encodes [2, maker, taker, conditional_taker] and on PlaceLimitOrderWithConditionals the parent uses taker, supplied triggers use conditional_taker, and all resting fills use maker. Other placements ignore conditional_taker and use the ordinary maker/taker pair. Other variants apply the same pair to the parent and its triggers. Standalone conditional placements retain both rates for execution.

The additional fee uses the existing trader/position placement authorization and account list; no extra accounts or fee permission are required. The fee applies in addition to the adjusted base trading fee and accrues only on fills.
This IDL is maintained from the native Rust program surface and includes explicit instruction, account, and event discriminators for transaction and account decoding.
PDA metadata is included where the program defines a canonical derivation; accounts without PDA metadata are supplied as explicit accounts or are stored in GlobalConfiguration.
